conclusions: An automorphism with the source fixed half-M and full-A label maps determines one full-L automorphism by the exact completion and overlap theorem. Comparison of actual coherent Tate markings at a geometric point supplies a lift to the integral PEL similitude group; no unrestricted surjectivity of reduction is asserted.

For an integral similitude, the original singleton lattice is unchanged. The half-level multiplier quotient is the full group of units modulo M. It acts freely on primitive roots and therefore freely on the complete toroidal space, including the boundary. The actual symmetric cubical line is relatively ample after each normal local completion by Lan Lemma4.2.1.6. Faithfully flat descent of relative ampleness supplies the quasi-projectivity used for effective descent of the semiabelian scheme and its exact line and action structures.

Prime-to-p torsion labels on the abelian locus extend uniquely by normality and finite etaleness. Properness extends the given point over the original valuation ring with its specified fraction field.

Normalization of the finite-type domain is finite because the original arithmetic DVR is excellent; the normalized domain remains inside the original valuation ring by integral closedness. Lan Proposition3.3.1.5 then extends the actual inverse comparisons over the noetherian normal stage, and their pullbacks give the original required comparison over the valuation ring.

This proves both the complete-DVR and nondiscrete unit-ball GoodRedExt clauses. Together with the independently reviewed whole-model integral theta supplier, the package supplies every stated LevelStructureConditions field.
